requirements.quote:
After a TCP connection is established, the first message sent by each
   side is an OPEN message.  If the OPEN message is acceptable, a
requirements.condition: After a TCP connection is established, for each side.
requirements.required_behavior: Send an OPEN message as the first BGP message.
requirements.why_checkable: The first transmitted message on a new TCP connection can be checked.

requirements.quote:
side is an OPEN message.  If the OPEN message is acceptable, a
   KEEPALIVE message confirming the OPEN is sent back.
requirements.condition: An incoming OPEN message is acceptable.
requirements.required_behavior: Send back a KEEPALIVE message confirming the OPEN.
requirements.why_checkable: The response to an acceptable OPEN is observable.

requirements.quote:
In addition to the fixed-size BGP header, the OPEN message contains
   the following fields:
requirements.condition: Encoding an OPEN message.
requirements.required_behavior: Include the fixed-size BGP header in addition to the OPEN fields.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized OPEN can be inspected for the common header.

requirements.condition: Encoding the OPEN message body.
requirements.required_behavior: Order the fields as Version, My Autonomous System, Hold Time, BGP Identifier, Optional Parameters Length, and Optional Parameters.
requirements.why_checkable: Field offsets and ordering are observable in serialized messages.

requirements.quote:
This 1-octet unsigned integer indicates the protocol version
         number of the message.  The current BGP version number is 4.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the OPEN Version field.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent Version as a 1-octet unsigned integer.
requirements.why_checkable: Field width and unsigned decoding can be checked.

requirements.quote:
This 1-octet unsigned integer indicates the protocol version
         number of the message.  The current BGP version number is 4.
requirements.condition: Sending an OPEN for the current BGP version described by this standard.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the protocol version number to 4.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted Version octet can be checked.

requirements.quote:
This 2-octet unsigned integer indicates the Autonomous System
         number of the sender.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding My Autonomous System in an OPEN.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent My Autonomous System as a 2-octet unsigned integer.
requirements.why_checkable: The field width and unsigned decoding can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
This 2-octet unsigned integer indicates the Autonomous System
         number of the sender.
requirements.condition: Sending an OPEN.
requirements.required_behavior: Set My Autonomous System to the sender's Autonomous System number.
requirements.why_checkable: The transmitted number can be compared with the sender configuration.

requirements.quote:
This 2-octet unsigned integer indicates the number of seconds
         the sender proposes for the value of the Hold Timer.  Upon
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the OPEN Hold Time.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent Hold Time as a 2-octet unsigned integer.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded width and unsigned decoding can be checked.

requirements.quote:
This 2-octet unsigned integer indicates the number of seconds
         the sender proposes for the value of the Hold Timer.  Upon
requirements.condition: Sending an OPEN.
requirements.required_behavior: Express the sender's proposed Hold Timer value in seconds in Hold Time.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted value and units can be compared with the proposed timer.

requirements.quote:
the sender proposes for the value of the Hold Timer.  Upon
         receipt of an OPEN message, a BGP speaker MUST calculate the
         value of the Hold Timer by using the smaller of its configured
         Hold Time and the Hold Time received in the OPEN message.  The
requirements.condition: Upon receipt of an OPEN message.
requirements.required_behavior: MUST calculate the Hold Timer value as the smaller of the configured Hold Time and the Hold Time received in the OPEN.
requirements.why_checkable: Configured and received values can be varied to check the resulting timer.

requirements.quote:
Hold Time and the Hold Time received in the OPEN message.  The
         Hold Time MUST be either zero or at least three seconds.  An
requirements.condition: Selecting or validating a Hold Time.
requirements.required_behavior: Hold Time MUST be zero or at least three seconds.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary values zero, one, two, and three distinguish the permitted values.

requirements.quote:
Time.  The calculated value indicates the maximum number of

requirements.quote:
This 4-octet unsigned integer indicates the BGP Identifier of
         the sender.  A given BGP speaker sets the value of its BGP
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding the OPEN BGP Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the BGP Identifier as a 4-octet unsigned integer.
requirements.why_checkable: The field width and unsigned decoding can be checked.

requirements.quote:
This 4-octet unsigned integer indicates the BGP Identifier of
         the sender.  A given BGP speaker sets the value of its BGP
requirements.condition: Sending an OPEN.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the sender's BGP Identifier in the BGP Identifier field.
requirements.why_checkable: The emitted identifier can be compared with the sender's identifier.

requirements.quote:
the sender.  A given BGP speaker sets the value of its BGP
         Identifier to an IP address that is assigned to that BGP
         speaker.  The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon
requirements.condition: Setting a speaker's BGP Identifier.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the BGP Identifier to an IP address assigned to that speaker.
requirements.why_checkable: The selected identifier can be compared with assigned IP addresses.

requirements.quote:
speaker.  The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon
         startup and is the same for every local interface and BGP peer.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker starts up.
requirements.required_behavior: Determine the BGP Identifier value upon startup.
requirements.why_checkable: Initialization of the identifier can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
speaker.  The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon
         startup and is the same for every local interface and BGP peer.
requirements.condition: A speaker has multiple local interfaces.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the same BGP Identifier for every local interface.
requirements.why_checkable: Identifier values across local interfaces can be compared.

requirements.quote:
speaker.  The value of the BGP Identifier is determined upon
         startup and is the same for every local interface and BGP peer.
requirements.condition: A speaker has multiple BGP peers.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the same BGP Identifier for every BGP peer.
requirements.why_checkable: OPEN identifiers sent to different peers can be compared.

requirements.quote:
This 1-octet unsigned integer indicates the total length of the
         Optional Parameters field in octets.  If the value of this
         field is zero, no Optional Parameters are present.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding Optional Parameters Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent Optional Parameters Length as a 1-octet unsigned integer.
requirements.why_checkable: The field width and unsigned decoding can be checked.

requirements.quote:
This 1-octet unsigned integer indicates the total length of the
         Optional Parameters field in octets.  If the value of this
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding Optional Parameters Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Set Optional Parameters Length to the total length of the Optional Parameters field in octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The declared length can be compared with the optional field byte count.

requirements.quote:
Optional Parameters field in octets.  If the value of this
         field is zero, no Optional Parameters are present.
requirements.condition: Optional Parameters Length equals zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include Optional Parameters when Optional Parameters Length is zero.
requirements.why_checkable: A zero-length OPEN can be checked for absence of optional parameters.

requirements.quote:
This field contains a list of optional parameters, in which
         each parameter is encoded as a <Parameter Type, Parameter
         Length, Parameter Value> triplet.
requirements.condition: Encoding an optional parameter in an OPEN.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode each optional parameter as a Parameter Type, Parameter Length, Parameter Value triplet in that order.
requirements.why_checkable: Each parameter's serialized structure and field order can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Parameter Type is a one octet field that unambiguously
         identifies individual parameters.  Parameter Length is a one
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding an optional Parameter Type.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a one-octet Parameter Type field.
requirements.why_checkable: The type field size can be checked.

requirements.quote:
Parameter Type is a one octet field that unambiguously
         identifies individual parameters.  Parameter Length is a one
requirements.condition: Identifying an optional parameter.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the Parameter Type value to unambiguously identify the individual parameter.
requirements.why_checkable: The type-to-parameter dispatch mapping can be inspected for ambiguity.

requirements.quote:
identifies individual parameters.  Parameter Length is a one
         octet field that contains the length of the Parameter Value
         field in octets.  Parameter Value is a variable length field
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding an optional Parameter Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Use a one-octet Parameter Length field.
requirements.why_checkable: The length field size can be checked.

requirements.quote:
identifies individual parameters.  Parameter Length is a one
         octet field that contains the length of the Parameter Value
         field in octets.  Parameter Value is a variable length field
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding an optional Parameter Length.
requirements.required_behavior: Set Parameter Length to the length of the Parameter Value field in octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The declared length can be compared with the value byte count.

requirements.quote:
field in octets.  Parameter Value is a variable length field
         that is interpreted according to the value of the Parameter
         Type field.
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding an optional Parameter Value.
requirements.required_behavior: Treat Parameter Value as a variable-length field.
requirements.why_checkable: Parameter handling can be checked for support of length-delimited values.

requirements.quote:
field in octets.  Parameter Value is a variable length field
         that is interpreted according to the value of the Parameter
         Type field.
requirements.condition: Interpreting an optional Parameter Value.
requirements.required_behavior: Interpret Parameter Value according to its Parameter Type.
requirements.why_checkable: The value decoder dispatch can be checked against the type octet.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the OPEN message is 29 octets (including the
   message header).
requirements.condition: Encoding or validating an OPEN message.
requirements.required_behavior: Require a minimum OPEN message length of 29 octets including the message header.
requirements.why_checkable: A message length boundary check can be inspected.
